title: Audit emitted PPC load-reserve/store-conditional state transitions
goal: Close a documented CPU-oracle investigation gap by exercising actual selected-translator word/doubleword reservation instructions with original game-free sequences and an independent state-transition oracle, retaining incompatibilities without modifying the SDK or startup harness.
acceptance: Generate and execute original aligned lwarx/stwcx. and ldarx/stdcx. fixtures through the unchanged approved selected translator and native SDK; bind exact input, configuration, generator, compiler, emitted output, runner and loaded core identities

Use an independent sequence oracle for big-endian loaded/stored data, conditional-store memory/CR0 consistency, XER SO propagation, no established reservation, consumption after either conditional-store outcome, context isolation and serialized intervening same-location writes including ABA. Do not demand success where spurious reservation loss is permitted or assign deterministic outcomes to architecturally undefined mismatched-address cases

Retain every demonstrated counterexample and distinguish investigation completion from passing reservation compatibility. Keep fixtures, runners, writable memory and processes private/isolated; no shared SDK repair, existing CPU/thread interface, title/startup admission, production atomic policy or game-derived code change

Require strict fresh-process nonce/case/typed completion and provenance checks, meaningful incorrect-result/incomplete/timeout controls and resource cleanup. Original expected-state fixtures or host callback models alone cannot establish emitted instruction correctness
validation: Run seeded fixed-edge sequences, at least three independent comparable processes, repeated/reordered cases and a held-out seed on Windows/Linux using supported host/generated sanitizers; preserve failures and document uninstrumented SDK coverage

Measure actual emitted instruction/sequence costs with raw samples and tails, document warmup and one-machine/instrumentation limits, and consider correctness before performance without claiming general ordering, Xenon reservation granules, full ISA or gameplay parity

Run public game-free checks and positive/negative oracle/evidence guards; publish exact commands, source/package/tool/binary/receipt identities, skips, self-review status and an actionable separately scoped repair/integration handoff
size: bounded original emitted-instruction diagnostic; no SDK repair or guest startup integration
